goal: Pocket Ledger: an offline-first expense tracker PWA that lets Maya (a bakery owner with poor signal at the market) log a cash expense in about 30 seconds.
architecture: React + Vite single-page PWA with no backend
Dexie (IndexedDB) is the only data store, table `expenses` indexed on [date+category] and a `recurring` table
Hand-rolled service worker `public/sw.js` (~40 lines): precache app shell on install, cache-first fetch

decisions.why: localForage was too slow for monthly queries at 5,000 rows and has no real indexes

decisions.what: Use a hand-written service worker instead of Workbox or vite-plugin-pwa
decisions.why: Workbox and the plugin both broke with Vite's hashed filenames/build

decisions.what: Plain CSS files, no CSS framework
Monthly CSV export lives in src/lib/exportCsv.js with columns date,category,amount,note
decisions.why: Maya's accountant has a macro that depends on those exact columns

constraints: Entry must take about 30 seconds on a phone
Audience is one non-technical user (Maya) on a phone
user_preferences: Keep answers short; the developer reads on a phone
No CSS frameworks, plain CSS only

files.note: recurring expenses form and logic (in progress)

recent_changes: Replaced localForage with Dexie and rewrote db.js
Removed Workbox and plugin attempts; added public/sw.js
Added CSV export with fixed columns
Added recurring table and basic form

failed_attempts.why_failed: slow month queries with 5,000 rows, no index support
conflicts with Vite hashed filenames, blank page after reload
manifest injection step throws during build

known_bugs: Entries made after midnight local time are saved under the previous day because toISOString() uses UTC; fix is to build the date from local date parts (not applied yet)
open_tasks: Make editing an existing recurring rule work
Write a test for recurring rule editing
Fix the timezone date bug (deprioritised for now)
do_not_change: Store all money as integer cents, never floats; format only at display
Do not reorder or rename the CSV columns date,category,amount,note
Do not reintroduce Workbox or vite-plugin-pwa
Do not add a CSS framework
current_state: Core entry, Dexie storage, offline service worker and CSV export work. Recurring expenses exist as a basic form and table but editing a rule is not implemented and untested.
next_action: Implement updateRecurring(id, patch) in src/lib/db.js and wire up the edit button in src/features/recurring/.
